name: magpie-agent-getkiki
description: Kiki (getkiki.ai) as a Magpie agent: Magpie's gateway and models in Kiki's pi models.json, and the model Kiki starts on in its .env

summary.en: Kiki (getkiki.ai), the Mac app where one chief of staff runs a team of AI agents: pick any Magpie model for Kiki and its team members, with account failover. Switch it off to put Kiki's files back.
summary.zh: Kiki（getkiki.ai）Mac 上的 AI 首席秘书，带一支 AI 团队：在 Magpie 里给 Kiki 和团队成员选任何模型，多账号自动轮换；关掉即恢复 Kiki 原来的设置。
